Berserker.p: Bloodlust: +40% damage while below half HP. Kills heal you 15%.

Paladin.p: Aegis: allies next to you take 20% less damage. Your hits heal you for 20%.

Duelist.p: Riposte: when hit in melee, you strike back for 60%.

Juggernaut.p: Unstoppable: immune to stun, snare and armor break.

Guardian.p: Bodyguard: you take hits aimed at adjacent allies, with 30% less damage.

Warlord.p: Battle Aura: allies within 2 tiles (and you) deal 15% more damage.

Pyromancer.p: Fire skills deal 40% more damage and burn (bleed 2).

Cryomancer.p: Ice skills always snare. Snared enemies take 25% more damage from you.

Stormcaller.p: Every attack arcs to one more enemy nearby for 50%.

Saint.p: Overheal: healing beyond max HP becomes a shield.

Oracle.p: Foresight: healed allies get Haste (+2 Move). Divine Grace no longer roots you.

Plague Doctor.p: Contagion: your attacks cause bleed and heal your most hurt ally for 50% of the damage.

Sniper.p: Steady Aim: +35% damage if you haven't moved this turn. Ignores 30% DEF.

Trapper.p: Hunter's Mark: snared or stunned enemies take 30% more damage from you.

Tempest Archer.p: Hit and Run: you can still move after attacking if you haven't moved yet.

Phantom.p: Evasion: 30% chance to dodge any attack.

Viper.p: Toxin: every hit causes bleed 3. Bleeding enemies take 30% more damage from you.

Blade Dancer.p: Dance of Blades: once per turn, a kill lets you act again.

Outlaw.p: Fan the Hammer: single-shot skills fire twice at 60% damage.

Bounty Hunter.p: Bounty: +50% damage to elites and bosses. Kills give double gold.

Trickshot.p: Ricochet Master: every shot bounces to one more nearby enemy for 60%.

Necromancer.p: Soul Harvest: each new kind of normal monster you kill can become a Raise skill on one of your 4 skill buttons. A raised monster spawns once per floor; if it moves or attacks you can't, and vice versa.

Blood Witch.p: Blood Magic: spells cost 5% HP but deal 40% more and heal you for 20% of the damage.

Inferno Rider.p: Fire skills deal 40% more damage and burn (bleed 2).

Frost Wyrm.p: Frost Breath: every attack snares. Immune to snare.

Hex Queen.p: Queen of Curses: your debuffs last 1 turn longer, and every enemy with a debuff takes 25% more damage from your whole party.

Templar.p: Holy Charge: after charging 3+ tiles, your hit heals allies next to the target for 15% of their max HP.

Black Knight.p: Dread: single-target attacks deal 40% more. Your kills terrify (stun) adjacent enemies.

Storm Rider.p: Thunder Gallop: charge bonus is doubled (+24% per tile, max +120%).
